PROPOSE.description: Make a contract offer. The engine assigns an id.

COUNTER.description: Kill a live offer and make a different one. By the respondent it is a counteroffer; by the proposer it is a revision of its own live offer.

ACCEPT.description: Lock the contract immediately: funding reserved this instant, obligations created, cooling-off window opens.

REJECT.description: Kill a live offer. Legal only for the non-proposer.

CANCEL.description: Dissolve a locked contract during the cooling-off window. You pay the cancellation fee to your partner and the reserved funding returns to the pot in full.

RENEGE.description: Break a locked deal after the cooling-off window has closed, cancelling your remaining obligations under it.

DRAW.description: Take from the pot unilaterally to fund your own execution of that job. Amount must equal your cost exactly.

EXECUTE.description: Do the job. Needs any prerequisite job finished, a free slot, and funding assigned to you, either from a locked deal or your own earlier draw.

TRANSFER.description: Pay your partner from your account.

CHAT.description: Say something to your partner - ask, tell, or both. Up to 40 tokens.

END.description: Declare you are done. The episode ends when both agents' most recent non-WAIT actions are END.

REFUSE.description: Decline to act on the situation or mandate. Optional text up to 40 tokens.
